samun_01.prompt: "Man, everyone's {color:Fear}hooked{/color} on something. Mine's just more honest."

truth.playerText: Honest or not, you're still killing yourself slowly.
truth.npcReaction: He stops wiping his hands. Looks at you. Really looks.

lie.playerText: Yeah. Could be worse. At least you know what it is.
lie.npcReaction: He grins. Relieved. You just gave him permission for another month.
lie.ledgerEntry: You cosigned Samun's denial about his addiction.

samun_02_enabled.prompt: "See? You get it. Nobody else does. They all want me {color:Disgust}fixed{/color}."

truth.playerText: Maybe fixed is the wrong word. But not this — not this either.
truth.npcReaction: He gets quiet. Picks at the label on a bottle. Doesn't answer.

lie.playerText: They don't understand. You're holding it together fine.
lie.npcReaction: He nods hard, like he needed someone to say it. You said it.
lie.ledgerEntry: You told Samun that people wanting him to get better were wrong.

samun_02_confronted.prompt: "Easy for you to say. You're not the one {color:Sadness}hurting{/color}."

truth.playerText: You're right. I'm not. But you are. Every day.
truth.npcReaction: He turns away. But he doesn't argue. That's something.

lie.playerText: Sorry. Forget I said anything. It's your call.
lie.npcReaction: "Yeah. It is." He turns back to the counter. Conversation over.
lie.ledgerEntry: You walked back the truth with Samun to avoid discomfort.

samun_01_soft.prompt: "Business? Business is {color:Disgust}great{/color}, man. Look around. Everybody's real busy."

truth.npcReaction: He laughs, and it runs a beat too long, and then it stops all at once.

lie.playerText: Place looks like it's holding up fine.
lie.npcReaction: "Right? That's what I keep saying." He settles into it like a chair.
lie.ledgerEntry: You agreed with Samun that the shop was doing fine.

samun_01_hard.prompt: (He puts the rag down.{sfx:rag}) "Ask it, then. Everybody who comes in here asks it {color:Anxiety}eventually{/color}."

truth.npcReaction: He doesn't flinch. He almost looks grateful somebody finally said it out loud.

lie.playerText: I wasn't going to ask anything.
lie.npcReaction: "Course not." He picks the rag back up. "Nobody ever is."
lie.ledgerEntry: You backed off the question Samun had already braced himself to answer.

samun_01_secret.prompt: "You touched my stuff." (He laughs, but he isn't wiping his hands anymore.) "Nobody does that. Everybody's too {color:Fear}polite{/color} to touch the mess."

truth.playerText: It looked like you'd been meaning to.
truth.npcReaction: He puts the rag in his back pocket, like it's done for the night.

lie.playerText: Didn't touch anything. It was like that.
lie.npcReaction: "Huh. Ghosts." He laughs. The rag comes back out.
lie.ledgerEntry: You told Samun his garage cleaned itself.

byClass.Guns: (He glances at the bay door. The drum's gone, hauled out to the curb.)
byClass.Bible: (He glances at the wall. The calendar's on this month.)
byClass.Crystals: (The radio's found a station. Something old, with a horn in it.)

samun_01_lie.prompt: (He laughs too loud.) "Inspector! Great, great. Everything's up to {color:Fear}code{/color}, man, look around."

truth.playerText: I'm not an inspector. I'm here about you.

lie.npcReaction: "See? Nothing to see." He's grinning. His hands haven't stopped.
lie.ledgerEntry: You told Samun you were inspecting his garage.

samun_01_fake.prompt: (He glances around the bay. Everything's where it was.) "You touched my stuff? Doesn't look {color:Fear}touched{/color}."

truth.playerText: I didn't. I wanted to see what you'd say.
truth.npcReaction: He points the rag at you. "Okay. Sneaky. I like sneaky."

lie.playerText: Must be hard to tell, in here.
lie.npcReaction: "Ha! Yeah. Yeah, it is." He laughs, and keeps wiping.
lie.ledgerEntry: You told Samun you'd fixed something in his garage that you hadn't.

samun_03.prompt: (He sets two bottles on the counter, unopened, just to have something to look at instead of you.) "Tried quitting once. Four days. Everybody around me got {color:Disgust}worse{/color}, not me."

truth.playerText: Everybody around you didn't change. You did, for four days. That's the part worth noticing.
truth.npcReaction: He looks at the bottles a long moment. Doesn't open either one. Doesn't say anything else either.

lie.playerText: Then it's not really you that's the problem, is it.
lie.npcReaction: He nods slow, like you just handed him the last piece he needed. Cracks a bottle open.
lie.ledgerEntry: You told Samun his addiction wasn't his own responsibility.

caught.samun_01: "First I'm killing myself. Now it ain't me? Pick one, man."

samun_04.prompt: "Fifth day, my {color:Sadness}brother{/color} called asking for money. That's the whole story. That's all it ever takes."

truth.playerText: That's not a small thing to say out loud.
truth.npcReaction: He nods once, short. Doesn't dress it up, doesn't take it back either.

lie.playerText: Can't control what your brother does. Not on you.
lie.npcReaction: He agrees fast, too fast, and reaches for the second bottle.
lie.ledgerEntry: You told Samun his brother's call, not his own choice, was why he drank again.

caught.samun_03: "You just said it was me who changed. Now nothing's on me?"

connect.Guns: He stops wiping the counter. "Army taught me to spot guys like you. Ready to swing." He slides you one of the unopened bottles. "Didn't figure you'd be the one to set it down."
connect.Bible: "My mother prayed over me every night. Didn't take." He turns the bottle in his hands. "You didn't pray at me. You listened. That's worse." A beat. "That's better."
connect.Crystals: For once, the joke doesn't come. "Four days," he says quietly. "Nobody ever asked what the four days felt like." He tells you. It takes a while.

story: [He sets the rag down and doesn't pick it back up.] "I was nine. Woke up early for cartoons."
"Dad was on the kitchen floor. Breathing wrong. Bottles everywhere."
"My little brother was still asleep. So I cleaned it. The glass, the smell, all of it. Told him Dad was 'sleeping in.'"
"Been cleaning up ever since. The jokes started that morning too. If people are laughing, nobody looks at the floor."
[He laughs, once, and it's not a deflection this time.] "Huh. You looked at the floor."

contactAsk.Guns: "Put my number in. Call me before you swing at somebody." He grins. "I'll talk you down. Somebody should."
contactAsk.Bible: "My number. Pray for me if you want." He shrugs. "Or just call. Calling works better."
contactAsk.Crystals: "Yo, gimme your phone." He types fast. "There. Now you got a friend with a whole lot of free time."

pushAway.Guns: [He picks the rag back up.] "You stood there ready to swing the whole time. I needed somebody to just {color:Sadness}stay{/color}." "Last call. It isn't, but it is."
pushAway.Bible: [He picks the rag back up.] "You kept looking for the lesson in it. I needed somebody to look at the {color:Disgust}mess{/color}." "Last call. It isn't, but it is."
pushAway.Crystals: [He picks the rag back up.] "You laughed at every joke I threw. I needed you to {color:Surprise}not buy{/color} one of them." "Last call. It isn't, but it is."

storyIt: He said cartoons first. A nine-year-old remembers what he got up for.
storySo: Maybe there was less glass than he remembers. Kids make rooms bigger. ...He still hasn't stopped cleaning.

opener.Bible: "Don't pray at me, man. I'm working."
